Process at a glance

Five stages from secure access to handoff

Use this sequence as the high-level route. The detailed screenshots and action notes below follow the same order.

01 Secure access Okta, Workspace ONE and Horizon virtual desktop.
02 Connect Authenticate Prisma and select the user certificate.
03 Locate customer Use the tracker sheet and CRM customer search.
04 Validate inputs Compare V6 and DCT details before building.
05 Generate & share Create in Airo, copy the preview URL and record remarks.
01
Stage 1 · Secure access

Access the GoDaddy virtual desktop

Authenticate through Okta, open Workspace ONE, launch the Prod desktop in Horizon, and sign in to the assigned virtual desktop.

Step 1

Sign in to the GoDaddy Okta dashboard

Open the GoDaddy Okta dashboard and complete the required username, password, and authentication flow. After authentication, the application dashboard is displayed.

↗ GoDaddy Okta dashboard
Okta application dashboard
Step 2

Open Workspace ONE and launch Prod

Select Workspace ONE Access from Okta. It opens in a new tab and may request authentication again. From the Workspace ONE app list, select the Prod desktop.

Prerequisite: the Horizon application must be installed by the IT team before launching the Prod desktop.
↗ Workspace ONE Access
Workspace ONE Prod tile and Horizon launch prompt
Step 3

Sign in to the virtual desktop

When the virtual desktop is available, sign in using the assigned user ID and the password already created for that account.

Virtual desktop sign-in screen
02
Stage 2 · Connectivity

Connect through Prisma

Prisma provides the required internet connectivity inside the virtual desktop and requires its own authentication and certificate selection.

Step 4

Authenticate to Prisma

Open Prisma from the virtual desktop and complete the requested username and password authentication.

Prisma authentication
Step 5

Select the user certificate and confirm connection

After authentication, choose the available user certificate and select OK. Once approved, Prisma loads the connected state.

Expected result: the Prisma session shows a connected state before continuing.
Certificate selection followed by connected environment
03
Stage 3 · Customer lookup

Open CRM and locate the assigned customer

Use email to transfer URLs/data between desktops where direct copy is unavailable, then use the tracker sheet to locate the customer in GoDaddy CRM.

Step 6

Use email for cross-desktop communication and open CRM

Open Chrome and sign in to email. The source process uses email as the communication medium between desktops because URLs/data cannot be copied directly from one desktop to the other.

Then open GoDaddy CRM and complete the authentication flow.

↗ GoDaddy CRM
Authentication before CRM access
Step 7

Take the Ticket ID / Shopper ID from the tracker sheet

Open the Google Sheet containing the assigned ticket or shopper details. Copy the relevant Ticket ID or Shopper ID into the CRM customer search.

Add your name in column F (Built By) for the row you are working on.

CRM customer search and tracking sheet
Step 8

Open the customer record and skip validation

After searching, the customer details / account validation view is displayed. Select Skip Validation and complete authentication again if prompted. The customer details then reload.

Customer data: the source document explicitly notes that these details must be handled carefully because they may contain customer-provided information.
Customer validation screen
04
Stage 4 · Input validation

Verify business details before building

Cross-check the customer data in V6 against the DCT before using those details to create the Airo mockup.

Step 9

Compare V6 with the DCT

Open the customer details in V6 and compare them with the DCT. Confirm that core details match before proceeding to Airo.

Business name
Domain
Phone
Other customer details required by the build
V6 / Customer Home details used for cross-checking
05
Stage 5 · Airo generation

Create the website mockup in GoDaddy Airo

Use the business industry and sitewide instructions as the build inputs, then allow Airo to generate the website mockup.

Step 10

Open Airo Builder and enter the industry-based prompt

Open Airo Builder. Replace [Industry] with the customer’s business industry shown in the business details.

Create a website for [Industry] using the attached information
↗ GoDaddy Airo Builder
Airo start screen and the industry field used for the prompt
Step 11

Prepare and attach the sitewide instructions

Copy the Sitewide Instructions. Ignore the AAB-generated URL, and copy the remaining instructions into a new Notepad document. Use that information as the attachment/input for the Airo prompt.

Important: do not include the AAB-generated URL when preparing the instruction content.
Sitewide instructions prepared and attached in Airo
Step 12

Generate the Airo website

Select Generate. According to the supplied process, Airo generates the content and uses matching customer media library assets and Getty imagery automatically where applicable.

Airo ready for generation
06
Stage 6 · Handoff

Share the preview and record review remarks

The final handoff is the shareable Airo URL, recorded in the tracker along with concise remarks on what can be improved.

Step 13

Copy the share URL and update the tracker

After generation, select Share, copy the preview URL, and paste it into the tracking sheet. Add remarks describing what can be done better in the generated mockup.

Open Share / Preview
Copy the generated URL
Paste the URL in the tracker sheet
Add improvement remarks
Airo share dialog used to copy the preview URL
